messages.subject: Problem to define/show rules
parts:
Hello together,
I use Rattle on zwo mashines. One is running Win 8.1, the other is Win 7.0.

By clicking "Ausführen"=explore  on the tab "Assoziieren"=Associate I get an overview on both mashines. It shows how many rules Rattle has found.
When I click the button "Regeln anzeigen"=show rules, I get the rules on the Win 8.1 mashine.
The win 7.0 shows nothing in the Rattle window. Instead the R-GUI window shows the following message:

Fehler in inspect(sort(crs$apriori, by = "support")) :
  Fehler bei der Auswertung des Argumentes 'x' bei der Methodenauswahl
für Funktion 'inspect': Fehler in sort.int(x, na.last = na.last, decreasing = decreasing, ...) :
  unbenutztes Argument (by = "support")
>
thanks for your support!
